name: autoclose-html
author: lumine-code
description: Close HTML and XML tags automatically as you type.
backgroundTips: You can have a closing tag written for you as soon as you finish typing an opening one.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Write the closing tag as soon as an opening tag is typed.

grammars.title: Grammars
grammars.description: Scope names of the grammars that get closing tags. `source.js` is left out by default because a comparison such as `a < b > c` reads as a tag.

forceInline.title: Force Inline
forceInline.description: Elements whose closing tag stays on the same line even though they are block by default. Use `*` to keep every closing tag inline.

forceBlock.title: Force Block
forceBlock.description: Elements whose closing tag moves to its own line even though they are inline by default. Ignored when Force Inline is `*`.

neverClose.title: Never Close Elements
neverClose.description: Elements that take no closing tag.

makeNeverCloseSelfClosing.title: Make Never Close Elements Self-Closing
makeNeverCloseSelfClosing.description:
